body:
The Choi et al. (2023) study, DOI [10.1128/aem.02048-22](https://doi.org/10.1128/aem.02048-22), supports narrow crocidolite-associated iron reduction and a chrysotile assay with no demonstrated magnesium/silicon release enhancement. These are not recovery or detoxification claims. The full PMC main text and all four original figures were inspected; the official supplement remains unavailable through tested routes.

The missing artifact is `aem.02048-22-s0001.pdf`, linked by the [publisher](https://journals.asm.org/doi/suppl/10.1128/aem.02048-22/suppl_file/aem.02048-22-s0001.pdf) and [PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/10304897/bin/aem.02048-22-s0001.pdf). Publisher requests returned 403, PMC download routes returned challenge pages, and EuropePMC reports the article outside its open-access subset. A browser surface was unavailable. These are access limits, not evidence that the file does not exist.

Follow-up work:

- Acquire the original supplement through a legitimate accessible route, verify file identity and record its checksum, version and reuse terms. Inspect its recipes, Tables S1-S4, Figures S1-S11 and extraction/beam controls before adopting additional quantitative claims.
- Reconcile chrysotile Results values (Mg 1.6 ± 0.11 mM in cultures and 0.87 ± 0.63 mM in medium alone) with Figure 2B bars and the stated 0.69 ± 0.08 mM inoculum correction. Determine which time point, background and correction each number uses; do not silently replace a figure or text value.
- Clarify Methods' statement that ICP-OES values subtract negative-control measurements, given separately displayed mineral-medium control series. Recover the exact blank/control definitions and calculation basis.
- Verify sample composition, preparation and extraction fractions without converting HCl-extractable Fe(II)/total-Fe fractions into recovered-metal yield. Resolve structural versus surface-coating iron only if additional evidence supports it.
- Save successor scientific reviews if new evidence materially changes `chrysotile.yaml` or `riebeckite.yaml`; preserve current observations and append history.

The narrow records retain these limitations. This issue tracks source acquisition and interpretation, not a known blocking defect in their qualitative accepted claims. No contact with authors is authorized by this issue itself.
title: Acquire Choi 2023 supplement and reconcile asbestos assay controls
